summary: The change rewrites required_approvals as a one-line conditional. It appears to behave the same, and the process records (approved ticket, independent approval on the final commit, passing CI on the head commit) are in order. However, required_approvals is the code covered by the exhaustive, non-rerunnable PAY-1 proof (ACR-0401). Under LAP-1 that proof lapses when the code changes, and no new exhaustive evidence was provided. The only remaining PAY-1 evidence is a control test labelled exhaustive that actually checks a fixed grid of amounts, so PAY-1 cannot be shown with the required strength and the change is held pending a re-run proof or equivalent evidence.
